item.title: Laxman informally approached by BCCI for Test coach role after poor results under Gambhir: Report
item.description: While India’s white-ball side has been performing exceptionally well under head coach Gautam Gambhir, producing trophies and strong win-loss records, that success has not translated to the traditional format. With Gambhir at the helm, India have won seven, lost 10 and drew two of their 19 Tests so far, which includes a couple of clean sweeps against New Zealand (0-3) and South Africa (0-2) at home. item.title: India squad for U-19 World Cup 2026 announced: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi features in Ayush Mhatre-led side
item.description: BCCI’s Junior Cricket Committee on Saturday (December 27) announced the India Under-19 squad for the upcoming three-match One-Day series against South Africa and the ICC Men’s Under-19 World Cup, scheduled to be held in Zimbabwe and Namibia from January 15 to February 6. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: WATCH – “There's been a lot thrown at this team,” Joe Root reacts to England’s MCG Test win
item.description: England registered a gutsy four-wicket victory over Australia in the Boxing Day Ashes Test that was all over inside two days at MCG. It was their first Test win Down Under in 15 years. The Three Lions bundled out Australia for 132 soon after lunch on Day 2, which left them chasing 175 to win. In the fourth innings, the tourists came out all guns blazing as Ben Duckett (34 off 26) and Zak Crawley (37 off 48) approached the chase like a T20 match. item.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal reveals Virat Kohli singing “Lagan Lag Gayi Re” to tease him during maiden ODI ton in Vizag
item.description: India opener Yashasvi Jaiswal revealed the funny side of batting alongside Virat Kohli and how the legendary batter teased him with Salman Khan's 'Tere Naam' song during the third ODI against South Africa in Vizag earlier this month. Jaiswal slammed his maiden ODI hundred (116* off 121) in that match, while Kohli scored 65 not out off 45 balls. item.title: “The level gets elevated,” Aakash Chopra’s take on Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli’s Vijay Hazare Trophy participation
item.description: Indian batting stalwarts Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli are currently plying their trade in the Vijay Hazare Trophy for Mumbai and Delhi, respectively. item.title: “Very fortunate to play under MS Dhoni and Stephen Fleming”: Faf du Plessis
item.description: Former South Africa skipper Faf du Plessis shared the experience of playing under MS Dhoni-Stephen Fleming regime in the Indian Premier League (IPL) for Chennai Super Kings (CSK).
